about.text: A dried dairy product of the Arabian Bedouin: churned buttermilk is heated until it curdles and the curd is dried into hard discs that keep for months.

facts.v: Mixed into mariss al-aqit at al-Muliha; used instead of flour in the Sha'atha dish al-Abeet; in Sha'atha, mixed with dates and ghee

sources.text: Its names and facts, from these.
